subject: maths

items.why: Vectors carry magnitude and direction; scalars have magnitude only.

items.q: What is the resultant of two vectors?
items.correct: The single vector with the same overall effect (tip-to-tail).
items.misconception: The difference of their sizes only.
items.why: Adding vectors tip-to-tail gives the resultant, accounting for direction.
